governance.description: Optional public governance metadata linking the keyset to a ceremony, publication, rotation, or revocation record. This metadata is contextual unless bound by local policy.

allowed_kinds.description: Envelope kinds this key may authenticate; use '*' only for broad test/demo keysets.

public_key.description: Raw Ed25519 public key bytes encoded according to public_key_encoding. Do not place private key material here.

retired_at.description: Optional retirement timestamp. A retired key may verify historical envelopes only when envelope issued_at is within the local policy validity window; it must not be used as a live signing authority.

keyset_id.description: Stable identifier for the offline verifier trust-root set. This is a policy object, not private key material.

scope.description: Human-readable jurisdiction/election/sandbox scope for this keyset. Verifiers treat this as context unless local policy binds it externally.

signature_policy.description: Optional bounded verifier policy for this public trust keyset. This is local verification policy, not proof of legal authority.

source_boundary.description: Public note describing whether the keyset is external trust-root material or a packet-contained negative-control copy. Verifiers enforce the path boundary, not this self-description.
